title: Psalm 141 (Septuagint) = Psalm 142 (KJV)
description: Psalm 141 in the Septuagint numbering (Psalm 142 in the KJV). Both the manuscript page scan AND the Greek text are taken directly from Codex Sinaiticus (4th century AD) via the Codex Sinaiticus Project (codexsinaiticus.org). The Greek transcription preserves the actual uncial forms, lunate sigma, nomina sacra abbreviations, and lectional marks of the manuscript. Library folio: 126. English translation verbatim from the King James Version (1611, public domain) via bible-api.com.
introduction:
This entry meets the strict three-criteria standard of the Theosis Library, with the manuscript text drawn directly from the same source as the scan:

  1. Manuscript scan: The actual folio of Codex Sinaiticus containing this passage, from the Codex Sinaiticus Project (codexsinaiticus.org). Library folio reference: 126.
  2. Original text: The verbatim transcription of the Sinaiticus manuscript from the Codex Sinaiticus Project, preserving uncial forms, lunate sigma, nomina sacra (e.g. ⟨θϲ⟩ = θεός), and scribal marks. Nomina sacra are shown in angle brackets to indicate the manuscript's sacred-name abbreviations.
  3. English translation: The King James Version (1611), retrieved verbatim from the public-domain bible-api.com endpoint.

Numbering: Codex Sinaiticus follows the Septuagint Psalter, in which this is Psalm 141. In the Hebrew and King James numbering the same psalm is Psalm 142. Greek verse numbers follow the Septuagint, which counts the superscription as verse 1; English verse numbers follow the KJV, so they run 1 behind the Greek. The Greek and English in each section are the same words of the same psalm.

translation.original_text: <sup>1</sup>ϲυνεϲεωϲ τω δαδ εν τω ειναι αυτον εν τω ϲπηλαιω προϲευχη <sup>2</sup>φωνη μου προϲ κν εκεκραξα φωνη μου προϲ κν εδεηθην <sup>3</sup>εκχεω εναντιον αυτου την δεηϲιν μου την θλιψιν μου ενωπιον αυτου απαγγελω <sup>4</sup>εν τω εκλιπειν εξ εμου το πνα μου και ϲυ εγνωϲ ταϲ τριβουϲ μου εν οδω ταυτη η επορευομην εκρυψαν μοι παγιδα <sup>5</sup>κατενοουν ειϲ τα δεξια και επεβλεπον οτι ουκ ην ο επιγινωϲκων με απωλετο φυγη απ εμου και ουκ εϲτιν ο εκζητων την ψυχην μου
translation.text:
<sup>1</sup>I cried unto the LORD with my voice; with my voice unto the LORD did I make my supplication. <sup>2</sup>I poured out my complaint before him; I shewed before him my trouble. <sup>3</sup>When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, then thou knewest my path. In the way wherein I walked have they privily laid a snare for me. <sup>4</sup>I looked on
my right hand, and beheld, but
there was
 no man that would know me: refuge failed me; no man cared for my soul.

translation.original_text: <sup>6</sup>προϲ ϲε κε εκεκραξα και ειπα ϲυ ει η ελπιϲ μου μεριϲ μου εν γη ζωντων <sup>7</sup>προϲχεϲ προϲ την δεηϲιν μου οτι εταπινωθην ϲφοδρα ρυϲαι με εκ των καταδιωκοντων με οτι εκραταιωθηϲαν υπερ εμε <sup>8</sup>εξαγαγε εκ φυλακηϲ την ψυχην μου του εξομολογηϲαϲθαι τω ονοματι ϲου κε εμε ϋπομενουϲι δικαιοι εωϲ ου ανταποδωϲ μοι
translation.text:
<sup>5</sup>I cried unto thee, O LORD: I said, Thou
art my refuge
and my portion in the land of the living. <sup>6</sup>Attend unto my cry; for I am brought very low: deliver me from my persecutors; for they are stronger than I. <sup>7</sup>Bring my soul out of prison, that I may praise thy name: the righteous shall compass me about; for thou shalt deal bountifully with me.

verification.section_folios_note: Each section links to the specific folio(s) containing its verses, resolved per verse via the Codex Sinaiticus Project page index.
